lantern_stone at (152.4,37.2) stands 1.6 m from the shore portal on the spine and fills strip frames 1-7. Move it off the line.
rock_cluster at (155.5,35.3) sits across the b3_shore spine (153.5,35.2)->(156.5,34.0) as a 2.4 m block in the shore entry view. Push it to the south wall foot, or remove it.

The r 9 shaft surface around (150,50) renders as a huge overexposed emissive cylinder that is the brightest object in b3_lazy, b3_geyser and here. Make it dark rock with openings (or glass) lit only by lava_wall spill.
Once the hero is see-through, check that the lava_window shows between the helix turns from the concept camera. If not, slide it west along the NE wall so it sits behind the tube from (143.6,38.8).

top_change: Replace the opaque 10x10x48 hero block with an open glass helix so the pool, tube and lava-wall stack of concept 13 can be seen.
